title: Mi Band 4 + xdrip - bolus data incomplete (lack of space on Mi Band screen, unnecessary data to be removed)
symptom: The bolus data shown on Mi Band 4 is incomplete (cut) because the line is too short and there is too much data to be shown. The user points out that the 'u' is missing and there is unnecessary 'at' text.
fix: The user suggests removing the part of the info containing 'at' to solve the problem. A patch was released by @bigdigital on his Patreon site.
evidence_quote: In my opinion the very simple solution to this problem is to remove the part of the info containing "at" pointed by right arrow.
